Our goal is to produce an operating system that has the features and capabilities that we need, and to have fun as we develop it. ## Licenses ROCKNIX is a Linux distribution that is made up of many open-source components. Common imaging tools include [Balena Etcher](https://www.balena.io/etcher/), [Raspberry Pi Imager](https://www.raspberrypi.com/software/), and [Win32 Disk Imager](https://sourceforge.net/projects/win32diskimager/).
